ErrorEnvelope.description: The standard error envelope (plan §4). Every error response carries this shape; `code` names the exact error, `message` is a human-readable description, and `details` carries structured context when present.

committed.description: Whether the write was committed despite the error (present for outcome-unknown commits)

details.description: Structured context specific to the error (absent when empty)

limit.description: The server-side cap that was exceeded (present for rate-limited or size-limited errors)

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong

request_id.description: The opaque request id, present in `5xx` responses

retry_after.description: The suggested seconds before retrying (present for overload/busy errors)
